sources.title: Hayward ColorLogic Specs, Parts & Error Codes | PoolDial
sources.snippet: The Hayward ColorLogic is a color-changing LED pool and spa light with multiple fixed colors and light shows. It integrates with Hayward OmniLogic and ProLogic automation systems for app-based control.

sources.title: ColorLogic® 120V Color LED Replacement Bulb - Browning Pools
sources.snippet: The ColorLogic® LED Replacement Bulb is the quickest, most cost-effective way to upgrade a standard incandescent pool light to a vibrant, color-rich, energy-efficient LED.
